sessions.includes: A full assessment, hands-on treatment where appropriate, and a home exercise plan to start with.
Ongoing treatment and progression of your exercise programme.
Focused soft-tissue work — booked on its own or alongside a treatment session.

courseLengthCopy: Most acute problems settle in 2–4 sessions; more complex or long-standing problems often need 4–8 or more. We'll give you an honest estimate at your first visit and review it as we go — no wasted sessions, no pressure to keep coming back.
insuranceNotes: An excess may apply — check your policy for the amount you're responsible for.
Most insurers ask for a pre-authorisation reference before your first session.
GP-referral rules vary by insurer; some require a referral letter, others accept self-referral.
Insurers typically approve a set number of sessions at a time — we'll let you know if we think you'll need more.

cancellation.policyCopy: Please give us at least 24 hours' notice if you need to cancel or rearrange, so we can offer the slot to someone else.
cancellation.insurerNote: Insurers do not pay for missed appointments. If you're claiming through insurance and miss a session without enough notice, the cost is yours to cover, not your insurer's.
